notes: The two genitive articles are decided separately under rule 57. In 'the one man's disobedience' the possessor stands before the head, so the inner τοῦ takes 'the' and the outer τῆς is `unrepresented`; in 'the obedience of the one' the possessor stands after the head, so each article takes its own determiner and the inner one carries 'of the' under rule 21.
οὕτως takes 'even so' headed on 'so' and the answering καί is `unrepresented`, the ASV writing no 'also' (rules 65 and 100).
